title: Project STAMP: Deterministic Verification Gates and Closed-Loop Context Repair for Multi-Arm VLA Task and Motion Planning
ledeHtml: Streaming unverified VLA poses to robot controllers causes IK failures, workspace collisions, torque spikes, and zone deadlocks. Project STAMP v1.0.0-stamp inserts a four-stage Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back loop between Gemini 4 Carbon and MoveIt 2 on ROS 2 Jazzy. Across 1,000 STAMP-Bench-V1 episodes, FrankaFR3DeterministicGate blocks all 610 injected fault episodes in under 2 ms, and write_limit_back raises completion from 39.0% to 100.0%.
hubTitle: Project STAMP: 4-Stage Deterministic Pre-Dispatch Gate & Closed-Loop Write-Back for Multi-Arm VLA
hubDesc: Intercepts 610/610 kinematic, collision, torque, and zone-lock faults across 1,000 episodes and raises task completion from 39% to 100%.
bodyHtml:
TL;DR: Key Findings and Benchmark Telemetry
  • Schema-enforced planner-to-controller boundary. GeminiArgonPlanner never publishes to ROS 2 topics directly. It outputs a Pydantic v2 and JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 TaskDAG verified against a 3D SpatialState snapshot before DecoupledROS2Executor or MoveItPreDispatchGuard dispatches any joint trajectory.
  • 100.0% fault interception across four orthogonal checks. FrankaFR3DeterministicGate checks every candidate TaskNode against 7-DoF Damped Least-Squares (DLS) IK reachability ([0.15 m, 0.85 m], residual ≤ 15.0 mm), 3D AABB collision clearance and table height (Z ≥ 0.20 m), URDF joint and torque bounds ([87..12] Nm), and multi-arm zone and tool time-window locks. Across STAMP-Bench-V1, the gate blocks all 610 / 610 fault-injected episodes in under 2 ms.
  • +61.0% completion gain from closed-loop write_limit_back. When the gate rejects a node, FeedbackContextStore.write_limit_back() formats each HardwareFaultLog as a quantitative [STAMP_GATE_FAULT ...] prompt bound. Re-planning with those bounds raises episode completion from 39.0% single-shot to 100.0% in two turns across 1,000 episodes (1.61 s total campaign runtime).

Why direct VLA-to-controller dispatch fails in multi-arm cells

Connecting an LLM or VLA tool-call output directly to ROS 2 action servers and MoveIt 2 controllers exposes multi-arm workcells to four hardware failure modes. Even when gemini-4-carbon decomposes a multi-step task in the right logical order, single-shot coordinate prediction still produces targets outside the arm's spherical reach, end-effector boxes that clip workbench fixtures, wrist postures that exceed distal torque ratings under payload, and overlapping schedules where two arms enter the same shared zone at once.

Project STAMP (Spatial, Task & Motion Planning, v1.0.0-stamp) places a deterministic pre-dispatch gate between multimodal planning and controller execution through a four-stage Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back loop. GeminiArgonPlanner emits only a declarative TaskDAG against a 3D scene snapshot (SpatialState). Neither DecoupledROS2Executor nor MoveItPreDispatchGuard can send a command to ROS 2 Jazzy until FrankaFR3DeterministicGate approves every node in the graph with GateVerdict.passed == True.

Project STAMP 4-Stage Closed-Loop Execution Pipeline (Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back) Ref: M9G-TR-2026-03 (v1.0.0-stamp)
Stage 1 (Plan): GeminiArgonPlanner(Goal, SpatialState, RepairHistory) builds a candidate TaskDAG.
Stage 2 (Gate): FrankaFR3DeterministicGate(TaskDAG, SpatialState) checks four orthogonal physical layers in under 2 ms.
Stage 3 (Execute on PASS): DecoupledROS2Executor dispatches verified 7-DoF joint trajectories to ROS 2 Jazzy and MoveIt 2.
Stage 4 (Write-Back on REJECT): FeedbackContextStore.write_limit_back(HardwareFaultLog) appends exact repair bounds for the next planning turn.

Four Pydantic v2 schema contracts and video-to-TaskDAG grounding

stamp/stamp_schemas/ defines four Pydantic v2 models exported as strict JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 contracts via export_all_json_schemas() so the planner, the gate, and external MCP clients share one typed boundary:

  • TaskDAG & TaskNode (TaskDAG.schema.json): Encodes a parallel multi-arm task graph where each node declares node_id, assigned manipulator arm_id (FR3_1, FR3_2, FR3_3), skill action, world target_pose [x, y, z, yaw] in meters and radians, upstream dependencies, claimed shared_zone, required_tool, and scheduled time_window (t_start, t_end).
  • SpatialState (SpatialState.schema.json): Records the 3D workcell snapshot at planning time, including per-arm base frames and 7-DoF joint states (RobotArmState with joint_torques_nm and custom URDF joint_limits_rad), tracked 3D objects (ObjectPose3D), 3D obstacle AABBs (WorkspaceZoneBox), and active lock maps (active_zone_locks, active_tool_locks).
  • GateVerdict (GateVerdict.schema.json): Returned by FrankaFR3DeterministicGate.evaluate_dag() with boolean passed, approved_node_ids, rejected_node_ids, pre-solved 7-DoF IK joint angle arrays joint_solutions in radians, and cumulative interception_rate.
  • HardwareFaultLog & FaultCode (HardwareFaultLog.schema.json): Binds each rejected node_id and arm_id to a typed FaultCode, scalar measured_value and limit_value, physical unit, and a correction_hint string formatted via to_context_constraint().

Mapping process video events to parallel FR3 TaskDAGs

MultimodalVideoIngestor (stamp/video_ingestion.py) converts multi-step process videos such as multi_dish_stir_fry_and_soup into parallel three-arm TaskDAG schedules. VIDEO_ACTION_TO_FR3_SKILL maps extracted video events onto parameterized Franka Emika FR3 skills and schedules earliest non-overlapping timelines across FR3_1 through FR3_3, shared zones, and fixture locks:

Four orthogonal checks in FrankaFR3DeterministicGate and write_limit_back repair

FrankaFR3DeterministicGate._evaluate_single_node() runs four orthogonal physical checks on every candidate TaskNode, and MoveItPreDispatchGuard.verify_moveit_goal() enforces the same invariants at the controller boundary. If any node violates a check, the gate rejects the TaskDAG in under 2 ms and passes a structured HardwareFaultLog to FeedbackContextStore.write_limit_back():

Four Orthogonal Physical Checks (FrankaFR3DeterministicGate) Ref: M9G-TR-2026-03 • stamp/stamp_gate/__init__.py
1. Kinematic Reach & 7-DoF DLS IK: Target 3D radial distance from the assigned arm base must sit within 0.15 m to 0.85 m, and the 150-iteration Damped Least-Squares IK position residual must stay at or below 15.0 mm (0.015 m).
2. 3D Workspace & AABB Collision: Target height must stay at or above 0.20 m, radial clearance from the base column must be at least 0.12 m, and the gripper bounding box (±[0.04, 0.04, 0.05] m) must not intersect any obstacle box.
3. Joint Position & Torque Envelopes: All 7 FR3 joint angles must stay within URDF position bounds and joint torques must remain within [87, 87, 87, 87, 12, 12, 12] Nm.
4. Spatio-Temporal Mutex Locks: Any two task nodes on different arms that claim the same shared_zone or required_tool must hold strictly non-overlapping [t_start, t_end] execution windows.
M9G-TR-2026-03 • Standardized Fault Taxonomy & Closed-Loop Repair Mechanics Author: Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G)
FaultCode Enum Deterministic Trigger Condition Injected Context Constraint (write_limit_back) Planner Turn-2 Repair Transformation
IK_UNREACHABLE 3D radial distance outside [0.15 m, 0.85 m] from the assigned arm's fr3_link0 base, or 150-iteration 7-DoF DLS IK residual exceeds 15.0 mm. [STAMP_GATE_FAULT node=... arm=FR3_k code=IK_UNREACHABLE measured=1.98m limit=0.85m]: move target within 0.52m of base Projects target XY radially along the base-to-target ray onto the r = 0.52 m target radius and clamps Z within [0.32 m, 0.62 m].
WORKSPACE_COLLISION Target drops below table height (Z < 0.20m), enters the 0.12m base column cylinder, or end-effector AABB intersects an obstacle WorkspaceZoneBox. [STAMP_GATE_FAULT node=... code=WORKSPACE_COLLISION]: End-effector AABB intersects obstacle; raise Z above box.max_z + 0.08m Raises target Z to max(0.34m, box.max_z + 0.08m), or retracts XY to 0.5 × base_xyz at Z = 0.38m when vertical clearance exceeds 0.68m.
RESOURCE_CONTENTION Two manipulators claim the same shared_zone (such as central_table) or required_tool during overlapping [t_start, t_end] windows or an active lock. [STAMP_GATE_FAULT node=... code=RESOURCE_CONTENTION]: Shared zone contended over [0.00s, 1.50s]; shift time_window after 1.50s Shifts the contending node's time_window to [mutex_cursor + 0.15s, mutex_cursor + 0.15s + dur] and clears conflicting foreign locks.
JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED Any of the 7 FR3 joint angles violates URDF [q_min, q_max] radians, or any joint torque exceeds [87, 87, 87, 87, 12, 12, 12] Nm. [STAMP_GATE_FAULT node=... code=JOINT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED measured=115.0Nm limit=87.0Nm]: retract moment arm & enable reduced_payload_mode Retracts target moment arm to 0.45 × base_xyz at Z = 0.38m, resets posture seed to FR3_HOME_CONFIG, and sets reduced_payload_mode = True.

STAMP-Bench-V1 telemetry across 1,000 fault-injected episodes

We measured the gap between unguarded single-shot VLA dispatch and Project STAMP's Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back loop on the 1,000-episode benchmark frozen in datasets/stamp_bench_v1/stamp_bench_v1_manifest.json (SHA-256 digest 8d8b72bb75c3865e...98b4c0aad, RNG seed 202703). Across 1,000 parallel three-arm episodes, the harness injected physical faults at a 60% target rate, producing 610 fault episodes and 1,076 node-level faults across out-of-reach targets at [1.42, -1.32, 0.34] m, central obstacle boxes, 115.0 Nm torque spikes on J1, and overlapping central_table time windows:

Deploying StampStandaloneEngine over HTTP REST and MCP stdio

StampStandaloneEngine (stamp/api_server.py) runs the entire Plan -> Gate -> Write-Back loop outside the simulator as a zero-ROS-dependency service over HTTP REST on port :8095 or JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP stdio. External agent harnesses pass custom robot URDF XML definitions (parsed per request by parse_urdf_joint_limits()) and reach bounds on every call:

M9G-TR-2026-03 • StampStandaloneEngine REST & JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP Interface Author: Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (M9G)
MCP Tool / HTTP Endpoint Input Contract Deterministic Engine Behavior & Output
stamp_plan_and_verify
POST /v1/stamp/plan_and_verify		 goal, spatial_state, optional urdf_xml, reach_bounds_m, video_events, max_replans Loads custom URDF revolute and prismatic bounds, runs ClosedLoopStampOrchestrator.run_episode(), and returns the verified dag, verdict, and active_write_back_constraints.
stamp_verify_dag
POST /v1/stamp/verify_dag		 Candidate dag (TaskDAG), spatial_state, optional urdf_xml, reach_bounds_m Runs FrankaFR3DeterministicGate.evaluate_dag() in under 2 ms, appends any HardwareFaultLog entries to FeedbackContextStore, and returns GateVerdict with pre-solved 7-DoF joint_solutions.
stamp_write_limit_back
POST /v1/stamp/write_limit_back		 List of HardwareFaultLog objects from simulator or hardware protective stops Formats hardware faults into deduplicated [STAMP_GATE_FAULT ...] prompt constraints and returns updated fault_summary counts by FaultCode.

Combined with the batch runner (scripts/run_stamp_batch.py), the WSL2 FastDDS heartbeat watchdog (scripts/fastdds_watchdog.py), and the SHA-256 dataset freezer (scripts/freeze_stamp_bench_v1.py), Project STAMP gives multi-arm ROS 2 workcells a fast, reproducible safety boundary for frontier VLA planners.

Research Provenance, Prior Art Disclosure & Anti-Scraping Notice

This technical report (M9G-TR-2026-03), the Project STAMP (v1.0.0-stamp) four-stage Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back architecture, the four-check FrankaFR3DeterministicGate design, and the 1,000-episode benchmark in STAMP-Bench-V1 (stamp_bench_v1_manifest.json) constitute original published prior art by Minsu Chang, Ph.D. (장민수 / M9G) on mincasurong.github.io. Copying, translating, or repackaging these tables, schemas, or analyses into third-party conference papers (IEEE ICRA, IROS, RA-L, CoRL) or arXiv preprints is prohibited.

ja.articleTag: M9G-TR-2026-03 • 時空間タスク＆モーション計画 (STAMP)
ja.articleTitle: Project STAMP: マルチアームVLAタスク＆モーション計画のための決定論的検証ゲートと閉ループ文脈修復
ja.articleLede: 未検証のVLA目標姿勢をロボット制御器へ直接送ると、逆運動学(IK)失敗、作業空間での衝突、関節トルクスパイク、共有ゾーンのデッドロックを招きます。Project STAMP v1.0.0-stampはGemini 4 CarbonとROS 2 Jazzy上のMoveIt 2の間にPlan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Backの4段階ループを挿入します。1,000エピソードのSTAMP-Bench-V1において、FrankaFR3DeterministicGateは注入された610件のフォルト全件を2 ms未満で遮断し、write_limit_backが完了率を39.0%から100.0%へ引き上げます。
ja.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR: 主要な知見とベンチマークテレメトリ
ja.finding1: スキーマ契約によるプランナーと制御器の境界分離。GeminiArgonPlannerはROS 2トピックへ直接送信せず、Pydantic v2およびJSON Schema Draft 2020-12準拠のTaskDAGのみを出力し、GateVerdict.passed == Trueを通過したノードだけをDecoupledROS2ExecutorとMoveItPreDispatchGuardが実行します。
ja.finding2: 4つの直交物理チェックによる100.0%フォルト遮断。FrankaFR3DeterministicGateは全TaskNodeに対し、7自由度DLS IK到達性 ([0.15 m, 0.85 m]、残差 <= 15.0 mm)、3D AABB衝突余裕とテーブル高さ (Z >= 0.20 m)、URDF関節・トルク上限 ([87..12] Nm)、共有ゾーン・ツールの時間窓ロックを2 ms未満で検査し、610 / 610件のフォルト試行を阻止します。
ja.finding3: 閉ループwrite_limit_backによる完了率 +61.0%向上。ゲート拒否時にFeedbackContextStore.write_limit_back()がHardwareFaultLogを定量的な [STAMP_GATE_FAULT ...] 制約へ変換してプロンプトへ戻し、1,000エピソード全てを2ターン以内に100.0%収束 (総実行時間1.61秒) させます。
ja.kpi1Note: 注入された610 / 610エピソードを遮断
ja.kpi3Note: フォルト制約により2ターンで100%回復
ja.kpi4Note: ベースライン610件に対し 0 / 1,000件

zh.articleTag: M9G-TR-2026-03 • 时空任务与运动规划 (STAMP)
zh.articleTitle: Project STAMP: 面向多机械臂 VLA 任务与运动规划的确定性校验门控与闭环上下文修复
zh.articleLede: 将未校验的 VLA 目标位姿直接下发给机器人控制器，会引发逆运动学失败、工作空间碰撞、力矩尖峰与共享区域死锁。Project STAMP v1.0.0-stamp 在 Gemini 4 Carbon 与 ROS 2 Jazzy 上的 MoveIt 2 之间插入四阶段 Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back 闭环。在 1,000 场 STAMP-Bench-V1 实验中，FrankaFR3DeterministicGate 在 2 ms 内拦截全部 610 场注入故障，write_limit_back 将完成率从 39.0% 提升至 100.0%。
zh.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR: 核心发现与基准遥测摘要
zh.finding1: 基于 Schema 契约的规划器与控制器解耦。GeminiArgonPlanner 从不直接向 ROS 2 话题发布指令，仅输出符合 Pydantic v2 与 JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 的 TaskDAG；仅当三维 SpatialState 校验通过后，DecoupledROS2Executor 与 MoveItPreDispatchGuard 才会下发关节轨迹。
zh.finding2: 四项正交物理校验实现 100.0% 故障拦截。FrankaFR3DeterministicGate 对每个候选 TaskNode 检查 7 自由度阻尼最小二乘 (DLS) IK 可达性 ([0.15 m, 0.85 m]，残差 <= 15.0 mm)、3D AABB 碰撞净空与桌面高度 (Z >= 0.20 m)、URDF 关节与力矩上限 ([87..12] Nm) 以及多臂区域和工具时间窗互斥锁，在 2 ms 内拦截 STAMP-Bench-V1 全部 610 / 610 场注入故障。
zh.finding3: 闭环 write_limit_back 带来 +61.0% 完成率提升。当门控拒绝节点时，FeedbackContextStore.write_limit_back() 将每条 HardwareFaultLog 转化为定量的 [STAMP_GATE_FAULT ...] 提示词约束，使 1,000 场实验在两轮内全部收敛至 100.0% 完成率 (总耗时 1.61 秒)。
zh.kpi3Note: 通过故障约束在 2 轮内 100% 恢复
zh.kpi4Note: 对比基线 610 次降为 0 / 1,000 次

es.articleTag: M9G-TR-2026-03 • Planificación Espaciotemporal de Tareas y Movimiento (STAMP)
es.articleTitle: Project STAMP: Compuertas de Verificación Determinista y Reparación de Contexto en Lazo Cerrado para Planificación VLA Multi-Brazo
es.articleLede: Enviar poses VLA no verificadas a los controladores del robot provoca fallos cinemáticos, colisiones 3D, picos de par e interbloqueos en zonas compartidas. Project STAMP v1.0.0-stamp inserta un ciclo de cuatro etapas Plan -> Gate -> Execute -> Write-Back entre Gemini 4 Carbon y MoveIt 2 sobre ROS 2 Jazzy. En 1,000 episodios de STAMP-Bench-V1, FrankaFR3DeterministicGate bloquea los 610 episodios con fallos en menos de 2 ms y write_limit_back eleva la finalización del 39.0% al 100.0%.
es.takeawaysHeader: TL;DR: Hallazgos Clave y Telemetría de Referencia
es.finding1: Frontera estricta entre planificador y controlador mediante esquemas. GeminiArgonPlanner nunca publica directamente en tópicos de ROS 2. Emite un TaskDAG en Pydantic v2 y JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validado frente a un SpatialState 3D antes de que DecoupledROS2Executor o MoveItPreDispatchGuard envíen trayectorias.
es.finding2: 100.0% de intercepción de fallos en cuatro chequeos físicos ortogonales. FrankaFR3DeterministicGate evalúa cada TaskNode frente a alcanzabilidad IK DLS de 7-DoF ([0.15 m, 0.85 m], residual <= 15.0 mm), colisiones AABB 3D y altura de mesa (Z >= 0.20 m), límites articulares y de par URDF ([87..12] Nm), y bloqueos temporales de zona y herramienta. En STAMP-Bench-V1 bloquea los 610 / 610 episodios con fallos en menos de 2 ms.
es.finding3: +61.0% en finalización de episodios mediante write_limit_back. Cuando la compuerta rechaza un nodo, FeedbackContextStore.write_limit_back() convierte cada HardwareFaultLog en una restricción cuantitativa [STAMP_GATE_FAULT ...] dentro del prompt, subiendo la tasa de éxito del 39.0% al 100.0% en dos turnos sobre 1,000 episodios (1.61 s en total).
